name: X-point collapse
blurb: An X-shaped magnetic null squeezed 20% out of its current-free shape, inside walls that hold the field lines crossing them (line-tied): its field cannot hold the current it carries, so the null collapses into a thin current sheet, where the field reconnects and drives jets out of its ends (Craig & McClymont 1991; Thurgood, Pontin & McLaughlin 2018). The reconnection setups follow the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
